lines: {target}? Cold water steals strength quickly. I would count everyone twice.
If anyone heads for Cold Ocean, tell them: Bring a boat and do not swim for pride. I will be at the loom.
Gray waves make distance feel heavier. I will remember that when I count everyone.
Cold Ocean is no small story. Fear scatters folk like a loose flock.
I will remember Cold Ocean as water that chills courage out of the bones. I will count heads before I count sheep.
